name: etabs-mcp
description: MCP server for CSI ETABS via the ETABS COM API
long_description: Servidor MCP para CSI ETABS mediante la API COM oficial. Permite crear y modificar modelos, definir cargas, ejecutar el analisis, extraer resultados y correr diseno estructural desde un agente de IA. Incluye 47 skills y ejecucion de codigo en sandbox.

tools.name: get_model_geometry
tools.description: Read point, frame, area, opening and story geometry through COM, without any desktop access.

tools.name: render_model_view
tools.description: Return 3D, plan or elevation PNG drawings generated from API geometry. No screen capture, mouse, keyboard or window access.

tools.name: discover_api
tools.description: Discover available API guidance and skills. Call this first before using other etabs-mcp tools.

tools.name: read_skills
tools.description: Read one or more skills by name. Each skill provides domain-specific guidance (geometry, loads, analysis, results, design).

tools.name: list_instances
tools.description: List all running ETABS instances with alias, PID, file path, and version.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Check the connection to ETABS. Returns connection state, version, model path, and lock status.

tools.name: prepare_session
tools.description: Open ETABS and prepare a saved empty model through COM without computer-use. New models use a separate ETABS process and a unique file.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the installed ETABS API contracts and Python calling conventions.

tools.name: execute_code
tools.description: Execute Python code in a sandbox against the ETABS COM API. The pre-connected 'model' variable is SapModel. Last expression or explicit 'result = ...' is returned.
